claims.claim_text: The indexed John T Nelson is a high-confidence match to the reviewed official record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Exact indexed name and a nonshared protected identifier agree with official Army bulk ordinal 8668618.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence. Exact name and a nonshared protected identifier agree in official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes identity but neither a named employer nor an OSS accession date.
claims.match_notes: No coded Army occupation is converted into employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for Leonard A Nelson conflicts with the name in the official Army bulk file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index identifies Leonard A Nelson, while the same protected identifier reaches Army bulk name FELLOWS ROBERT R.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting; the identifier cannot be assigned to the indexed person without direct personnel-file evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: No employment or pre-OSS affiliation is accepted from the conflicting Army row.
claims.match_notes: Keep the conflict visible and inspect Box 555 and the original personnel file.
